work_experience.title: Director, IT Application Services
description: Responsible for directing the Application Services division's activities that support all Clinical, RevCycle, Patient Access, Financial, and Analytics operations of a multi-site health system enterprise.

Lead and manage Epic implementations for hospital acquisitions and community affiliates which includes developing scope and requirements, developing project timelines, workflow redesigns, data migration activities, integrations with 3rd party vendors, managing project risks, aligning resources where needed, developing and executing go-live implementation plans, managing post go-live issues and operational oversight to achieve system stability and ensure business areas achieve expected goals.
Plan and execute system optimization initiatives.
Work with executive teams to plan, prioritize, and implement system strategies that support the organization's strategic goals.
Establish and maintain key relationships with operational leaders, vendors, local agencies, and peer organizations.
Collaborate with the CIO/CMIO to develop IT strategies, standards, and budget.
Oversee multiple large-scale projects, including development, installation, and major modification of systems from concept to full operation across the enterprise.
Developed and executed the organization's information exchange and connectivity integration strategy with HIEs and external agencies.
Conduct research and evaluation of new technologies and IT industry trends related to data administration, capacity planning, training, and application support.
Develop specifications for purchases, evaluate proposals, and initiate procurement. Ensure vendors are performing to contractual expectations.
Developed and continue to oversee the IT division’s project portfolio and resource capacity planning process. Implemented the methodologies to support the intake, review and planning efforts.

Managed and directed the IT team's operations to support these initiatives and continued workflow optimization efforts.
Directed the implementation of projects, ensuring objectives and projected timelines were achieved.
